title.narrative: Improving local health systems for marginalised populations by linking health and social justice
Verbesserung lokaler Gesundheitssysteme für marginalisierte Bevölkerungsgruppen durch die Verknüpfung von Gesundheit und sozialer Gerechtigkeit

description.narrative: Das Gesundheitssystem der Philippinen besteht aus einem öffentlichen und einem privaten Sektor. The Philippine healthcare system consists of a public and a private sector. Public healthcare is administered by the Department of Health. Private institutions and hospitals often have better facilities and shorter waiting times. In addition, healthcare services in urban areas are generally better developed than in rural or remote regions. The aim is to reduce inequalities by linking health and social justice in local health systems.
